structured.answer: After 8 years, putting in 500 ₪ a month, I'd have about 68,853 ₪ (I put in 48,000). For 4 years the calculator gives no number for self-employed people. It only says you'd pay tax before 6 years, so I'd ask.

stuck.why: The bars for years 1-5 are empty and there's no amount for the fund. The only number, 25,725, is for 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך', which isn't what I asked about.
I wasn't given amounts, so I kept 500 ₪ and 7% without knowing if 7% is realistic.

findings.what: For self-employed people, there's no result for withdrawing before 6 years, only empty boxes and a note. A number from another product (25,725) is shown in the same spot, which is confusing.
Red/pink 'לפני 6 שנים: מס' is alarming without saying how much
A dark background and grey small text are hard to read
'מסלול מדד' and S&P are used without explanation
